t: You're looking at the Presbyterian Church of St Andrew in Hampstead, a church building in Camden. Several notable people are buried here. William Harvey was the physician who first described in detail how blood circulates around the body, pumped by the heart. Henry Coley was an astrologer and mathematician. Admiral Sir Eliab Harvey took his ship HMS Temeraire into the thick of the Battle of Trafalgar. Sir Robert Mordaunt, who died in 1638, is buried here too.
